item.priorityBasis: Editorial design reference, not a runtime quality or performance benchmark
inspiration: Koei's creator-hosted collection includes distinctive fictional firearms, from boltpistol and paired heavy-gun concepts to energy and flame weapons. Its mixed melee/gun content is not mistaken for a melee-only accessory pack.
cautions: The creator announces TaCZ 1.1.5+ support and Afdian distribution. An exact current downloadable file, Minecraft version/loader pair, edition price and payment requirement were not independently established. Follow the creator's pinned distribution post; no third-party reseller is linked.
Video likes and views are not gunpack downloads, ratings or favorites.
Source research only; not independently installed or tested in Minecraft.
